title: Gerrity Stone
description: gerritystone.com zoominfo.com/c/gerrity-stone-inc/48615647 GerrityStone, Inc. is a family-owned stone fabrication and installation company founded in 1997 (part of the Gerrity family business dynasty dating back to 1906), based in Wilmington, Massachusetts, with a state-of-the-art 44,400 sq ft fabrication facility opened in 2022. It is a private, self-funded company with estimated annual revenue of ~$4.4M (range $1–10M) and 43–53 employees. GerrityStone operates the largest natural stone inventory in New England — 2,000+ slabs across 300+ colors, imported mainly from Italy and Brazil. The company offers full-cycle service (digital templating, CNC/water-jet fabrication, installation) and was the first new authorized Cambria quartz fabricator in 10 years. It has won "Best of Boston Home" multiple times (2009, 2010, 2024)
